<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.32.0 -->

## What's Changed
### New Features 🎉
* Support markdown links in`st.radio` options by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8028
* Improve error handling in `st.write_stream` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8036
* Add support for PIL images in `st.write` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8039
* add: Supprt for HTTP <Head> method to /healthz endpoint by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8145
* Add support for AzureOpenAI chat stream by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8107
* Add `st.popover` layout container by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/7908
* AppTest `from_function` args by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8183
* Subtitles changes for `st.video` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8057
* Expander and Status AppTest wrappers by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8187
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* Add support for converting `st.query_params` to string by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8030
* Fix custom dataframe scrollbars in Chrome by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8034
* Fix `time_input` menu colors in dark mode by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8056
* Make shallow copies of options returned from ensure_indexable by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8064
* Fix memory leak in runtime coroutine loop by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8068
* Prevent pandas keyerror when checking color column format in st.map by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8079
* Fix #7954 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8054
* Fix issue using a local path with `st.image` on windows. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8092
* Fix: `st.page_link` & `st.switch_page` handling / prefixed paths by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8085
* Fix script runner stack overflow by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8100
* Normalize main script path in `st.switch_page` and `st.page_link` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8103
* Fix: `st.page_link` URL preview shows file path by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8086
* Support multiple path characteristics for switch_page and page_link by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8127
* Fix chart exception where color-handling code expected DF index to start at 0 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8158
* Fix: Alert element overflow by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8194
* Fully clear App State on page change by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8208
* Make st.help more resilient with conditional members by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8228
### Other Changes
* Expire session storage cache on an async timer by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8083
* Lazy-load emoji module to improve performance by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8109
* Lazy-load pandas and pyarrow to improve performance by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8125
* Miscellaneous docstring edits and argument names by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8118
* Deprecate the `deprecation.showPyplotGlobalUse` config option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8133
* Use env variable to configure matplotlib backend by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8113
* Lazy-load numpy and pillow to improve performance by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8134
* Show a warning when server port `3000` is used by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8152
* Fixed typos in example documentation by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8162
* Increase time until timeout warning is shown for a custom component by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8179
* Update glide-data-grid to version 6.0.4 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/7779

## New Contributors
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8079
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8017
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8145
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8162

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/compare/1.31.1...1.32.0
